names: the event rule counts a report filed ON a dated value's own day as after it (W82): a CIQ export panel dated the day of a 10-Q, 10-K, 8-K item 2.02 or a foreign or transition filer's report is refused at the build, and R1's close on CIQ's history is refused (its value withheld, its recipe kept) where the company reported on the close's day, the note saying 'on the day of' rather than 'after'; the ex-lease close keeps the strict reading by ruling, being CIQ's pricing date of its own quarter's report; the filing list the event rule reads includes the start day
